config.experiment: Experiment 82.4.6.2 — SCMR-DA-SRPE Full-Path Training Membership Extension
config.protocol: Intentional test-label exposure diagnostic. Change only the two registered fold membership arrays, their sampling/class weights and statistics; use exact historical model, state, loss, RNG and training settings.

parent_training_config.best_selection: First strict maximum outer test-fold ACC under the historical val=test protocol

evidence.ema_variance_arithmetic: all-float64 sample count quotient and moment updates

registered_decision.strict_parity: five unrounded fold means at least DARG, patient net >= 0; report exclusion separately
registered_decision.nontrivial_residual: nonzero features, measured probability response, and same-weight net > 0 or BA delta > 0 following independent gradient audit
registered_decision.candidate: strict parity, nontrivial residual, DARG paired ACC/BA/net > 0 in all 10 folds and excluding fold 2, and medical vs matched anonymous paired ACC/BA/net > 0 with observable hard flips; ACC and BA wins >= losses in both patient scopes

training.base: E61 epoch-10 full warmup, loaded independently for every fold
training.checkpoint_selection: strict test-fold ACC improvement; first epoch at each new maximum
training.schedule: interleave groups within fold order; every task independently restores its matching E61 epoch-10 warmup

historical_configuration.reference_base: E61 epoch-10 full warmup, loaded independently for every fold
